reproduction.method: Actual MCP stdio notifications and mock HTTP bridges, with controlled stalled responses and shared callers

checks.name: cancellation stops protocol 1 ticket polling without replay or context reads
cancellation stops protocol 2 ticket polling without replay or context reads
cancellation closes a stalled acknowledgement body without replaying accepted work
cancellation closes a stalled poll body without replaying accepted work
cancellation closes a stalled legacy body without replaying accepted work
cancellation during protected retry backoff stops further submissions
one cancelled observer cannot abort shared capability negotiation
the last cancelled capability observer closes shared work and permits a fresh call
shared discovery survives one cancellation without submitting the cancelled command
cancelled discovery closes its last ping and remains discoverable on the next call
cancelled project-context resource reads close the HTTP body
cancelling selection validation preserves the selected project
cancelled automatic context injection remains available to the next call
cancelled direct queue reads release their HTTP request
cancellation stops test-job follow-up polling without stopping the Unity job
unknown and completed cancellation IDs leave another request intact

limitations: Uses cancellation supplied by the pinned MCP SDK; does not certify every client implementation.
Stopping observation is not rollback or cancellation of an accepted Unity operation.
In-flight submissions can already have been accepted even without an acknowledgement.
Already-started Hub processes retain their process deadlines; installers are not terminated by client cancellation.
Synchronous JavaScript cannot be interrupted while it occupies the event loop.
Live evidence uses Windows and Unity 6000.6.2f1; older-editor runtime validation remains deferred.
